title: Ryobi R18PD3-215GZ One+ 2 x 1.5Ah Cordless Drill Starter Kit
description: The Ryobi R18PD3-215GZ Cordless Combination Drill is ideal for drilling wood, metal, masonry, plastic, plasterboard, ceramic and tiles. A combination drill with 3 functions: drill, hammer drill and screwdriver. Hammer mode adds extra impact force for drilling hard materials such as concrete, brick and stone. Perfect for installing curtain rails, TV stands, shelves and outdoor lights. A 2-speed gearbox delivers 500/1800 rpm and up to 50 Nm of torque for versatility with different materials and multiple applications. Torque settings allow you to flush the screws every time for a better finish, while the LED light makes it easy to work in poorly lit areas. A ratchet chuck improves grip strength, making this tool compatible with all standard drilling and screwing bits up to 13mm. The integrated bit storage clip keeps the double-ended bit (flat head/Pozi) stored on the tool and within easy reach. This starter kit includes two 1.5Ah ONE+ lithium-ion batteries and a charger. Bare Tools range to expand your ONE+ collection. All ONE+ batteries and chargers are compatible with all ONE+ tools.
